title: Hook bypass via enable mode in module installation
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** High  **Likelihood:** Low  ## Description  The Nexus smart account uses a hook mechanism to implement pre-checks and post-checks for operations like module installation. However, there's a vulnerability where these hooks can be bypassed when modules are installed via the Module Enable Mode in `validateUserOp`.
